background.description: man looking at large barns full of harvest, darker sky above suggesting eternity

slides.notes: Main text. Read the whole parable.

slides.text: You can be rich in this world and still be poor before God.

slides.heading: What makes a life successful?
slides.body: Not what we possess, but what matters in eternity. He prepared everything except his soul.

slides.heading: My fruits. My barns. My goods.

background.description: barns filled with crops, overflowing harvest

slides.heading: Not his possessions, but his priority
slides.body: The danger is not having possessions. The danger is when our possessions possess us.

slides.text: He planned for many years. God knew he had only one night.

slides.heading: Do not give God the leftovers

slides.text: He was prepared to live, but not prepared to die.

slides.heading: He prepared everything except his soul
items: Empty: soul, eternity, relationship with God

slides.heading: Two different answers
items: The rich fool: I will keep everything for myself.
Jesus Christ: I will give Myself for you.

background.description: simple cross silhouette against a soft evening sky

slides.text: Salvation is by grace through faith in Jesus Christ.
Do not build everything and neglect your soul.
Do not spend your whole life becoming rich in things you cannot keep, while remaining poor in the things you can never afford to lose.
